annotations.title: Offset, abbreviation and daylight saving changes for a zone

description: Use when you need to answer "what is the UTC offset of X", "does X observe daylight saving" and "when do the clocks change". Returns the current offset and abbreviation, whether the place observes DST, every clock change in the year with exact local before and after times, and the next change. Abbreviations like IST or CST are ambiguous, so the answer says which zone was used.

place.description: City, IANA zone or abbreviation, e.g. "London" or "America/Phoenix".

year.description: Year to list clock changes for. Default this year.
